The use, care and general knowledge of small firearms - pistols, SMGs and rifles.
The operation and maintenance of really big guns - miniguns, rocket launchers, flamethrowers and such.
The care and feeding of energy-based weapons.  How to arm and operate weapons that use laser or plasma technology.
A combination of martial arts, boxing and other hand-to-hand martial arts.  Combat with your hands and feet.
Using non-ranged weapons in hand-to-hand, or melee combat - knives, sledgehammers, spears, clubs and so on.
The skill of muscle-propelled ranged weapons, such as throwing knives, spears and grenades.
General healing skill.  Used to heal small cuts, abrasions and other minor ills.  In game terms, the use of first aid can heal more hit points over time than just rest.
The healing of major wounds and crippled limbs.  Without this skill, it will take a much longer period of time to restore crippled limbs to use.
Quiet movement, and the ability to remain unnoticed. If successful, you will be much harder to locate. You cannot run and sneak at the same time.
The skill of opening locks without the proper key. The use of lockpicks or electronic lockpicks will greatly enhance this skill.
The ability to make the things of others your own.  Can be used to steal from people or places.
The finding and removal of traps.  Also the setting of explosives for demolition purposes.
Covers a variety of high technology skills, such as computers, biology, physics and geology.
The practical application of the Science skill for fixing broken equipment, machinery and electronics.
The ability to communicate in a practical and efficient manner. The skill of convincing others that your position is correct. The ability to lie and not get caught.
Trading and trade-related tasks. The ability to get better prices for items you sell, and lower prices for items you buy.
The knowledge and practical skills related to wagering. The skill at cards, dice and other games.
Practical knowledge of the outdoors, and the ability to live off the land. The knowledge of plants and animals.

Raw physical strength. A high Strength is good for physical characters. Modifies: Hit Points, Melee Damage, and Carry Weight.
Coordination and the ability to move well. A high Agility is important for any active character. Modifies: Action Points, Armor Class, Sequence, and many skills.
Fate. Karma. An extremely high or low Luck will affect the character - somehow. Events and situations will be changed by how lucky (or unlucky) your character is.
How much damage your character can take before dying.  If you reach 0 HP or less, you are dead.

At the end of each day, your character will heal 1 HP for each point of Healing Rate.  When you rest, you heal every six hours.
The chance to cause a critical hit in combat is increased by this amount.
Any damage taken is reduced by this amount. Damage Resistance can be increased by wearing armor.

Points earned by going up a Level. Can be used to increase a skill by 1%, or a tag skill by 2%, per point spent.
The general competency of the player character. A measure of your experience and abilities.
A reward for completing specific tasks, or defeating enemies in combat. More experience points are required to attain higher Levels.
What the world knows of your actions and deeds. This will modify NPC reactions.
The effects of actions that you have taken.  Important information will be displayed.

With Awareness, you are given detailed information about any critter you examine.  You see their exact hit points and information about any weapon they are equipped with.
You have learned the secret arts of the East, or you just punch faster.  In any case, your Hand-to-Hand attacks cost 1 AP less to perform.
Experience in unarmed combat has given you the edge when it comes to damage.  You cause +2 points of damage with hand-to-hand and melee attacks for each level of this Perk.
For each level of Bonus Move, you get 2 free APs each turn that can only be used for movement.  In other words, you can move 2 free hexes each turn for each level of this Perk.
Your training in firearms and other ranged weapons has made you more deadly in ranged combat.  For each level of this Perk, you do +2 points of damage with ranged weapons.
This Perk allows you to pull the trigger a little faster and still remain as accurate as before.  Each ranged weapon attack costs 1 AP less to perform.
You are more likely to move before your opponents in combat, since your Sequence is +2 for each level of this Perk.
With each level of this Perk, you get a +2 bonus to your Healing Rate.  This is in addition to your normal healing rate, thus you heal faster.
You are more likely to cause critical hits in combat if you have this Perk.  Each level of More Criticals gets you an additional +5% chance to cause a critical hit.
With the Night Vision Perk, you can see in the dark better.  This will reduce the overall darkness level by 20%.
You command attention by just walking into a room.  The initial reaction of another person is improved by 10% for each level of this Perk.
You are better able to avoid radiation and the bad effects radiation causes.  Each level of this Perk improves your Radiation Resistance by 15%.
When you are tough, you take less damage.  Each level of this Perk adds +10% to your general damage resistance.
AKA Mule.  You can carry an additional 50 pounds of equipment for each level of this Perk.

You have a talent for hitting things at longer distances.  For each level of this Perk, you get a +2 bonus to Perception for the purposes of determining range modifiers.  It's easier than ever to kill at long range!
With this Perk, you now have the ability to move quickly and still remain quiet.  You can Sneak and run at the same time.  Without this Perk, you would automatically stop Sneaking if you ran.
You are a master of the outdoors.  This Perk confers the ability to survive in hostile environments.  You get a +25% bonus to Outdoorsman.
You have mastered one aspect of bartering - buying goods far more cheaply than normal. With this Perk, you get a 25% discount when purchasing items from a store or another trader.
Each level of Educated adds +2 skill points when you gain a new experience level. This Perk works best when purchased early in your adventure.
The healing of bodies comes easier to you with this Perk. Each level of this Perk heals 4-10 additional hit points when using the First Aid or Doctor skills.
You have the talent of finding money. You find additional money in random encounters in the desert.

The critical hits you cause in combat are more devastating. You gain a 20% bonus on the critical hit table, almost ensuring that more damage will be done. This does not affect the chance to cause a critical hit.

You have studied other human beings, giving you inside knowledge of their emotional reaction to you.  You will see the reaction level of the person you are talking to when involved in an indepth conversation.
The Slayer walks the earth!  In hand-to-hand combat all of your hits are upgraded to critical hits, causing destruction and mayhem.
You have mastered the firearm as a source of pain.  With this Perk, any successful hit in combat with a ranged weapon will be upgraded to a critical hit if you also make a Luck roll.
While Sneaking, if you hit a critter in the back, you will cause double damage using a hand-to-hand attack.  Silent Death is that kind of Perk.
Each level of Action Boy (insert Girl if you wish) gives you an additional AP to spend every combat turn.  You can use these generic APs on any task.
Mental Block is the ability to tune out any outside mental interference.  You must have learned this talent from a passing guru, or from a really late night at a bar.
With each level of this Perk, you gain an additional 4 Hit Points every time you advance a level.  This is in addition to the hit points you already gain per level based off of your endurance.
You are less likely to be hit in combat if you have this Perk. You gain a +5 to your Armor Class, in addition to the AC bonus from any armor worn.
Yum! Tastes like chicken. For each level of this Perk, you gain +25% to your Poison Resistance.
This Perk will give you a one-time bonus of +10% to the Repair and Science skills.  A little late night cramming never hurt anybody, especially you.
The Medic Perk gives you a one-time bonus of +10% to the First Aid and Doctor skills.  Healing skills are a good thing.
A Master Thief is proficient at stealing and picking locks. You gain +15 to Stealing and Lockpicking.  Steal from the rich, and give to you.
Being a Speaker means you have a one-time bonus of +20% to Speech.  From the mouth of babes and all that.
Each level of the Heave Ho! Perk gives you an additional +2 to Strength (up to 10,) for purposes of determining range with thrown weapons only. This Perk will not exceed a weapon's maximum range.
You are much more adept at stealing than the normal crook. You can steal with the best of them, because with this Perk, you ignore size and facing modifiers when stealing from a person.
When the sun goes down or you are in a poorly lit area, you move like a ghost with this Perk.  Your Sneak skill is enhanced +20% in dark conditions.

Your reputation is always positive to people. Without this Perk, a large negative reputation would have a bad effect on good natured people. This works in the reverse as well. Evil people will even treat Mr. Goodie Good as one of the gang.
You can find more ammo than the normal post-holocaust survivor. This Perk doubles the amount of ammo found in random encounters.
With this Perk, you are less likely to be reliant to chems (50% less likely, actually), and you suffer half the withdrawal time of a normal person.
The Pathfinder is better able to find the shortest route.  With this Perk, your travel time on the World Map is reduced by 25% for each level.
Animals will not attack one of their friends, unless the animal is threatened or attacked first.  Exactly what an animal is in this world is open to debate.

You have improved your ability to see distant locations, increasing the size of explorations on the World Map by one square in each direction.  You also have a better chance of finding special encounters.
With this Perk, you have gained the attention of a Mysterious Stranger, who will appear to help you from time to time.  If your ally is lost in combat, do not expect him (or her) to be replaced.
You gain a +15% toward your Outdoorsman skill.  You are more likely to avoid random encounters if you choose, and tend to find those "special" encounters more than most.
You have learned to pack your equipment better.  Accessing your inventory only costs you 2 Action Points in Combat instead of 4.

You have learned to increase your dialog options without understanding what you're talking about.  Each level of this Perk will increase your Intelligence by one, up to 10, for purposes of dialog only.
You are indeed a Swift Learner with this Perk, as each level gives you an additional +5% bonus whenever you earn experience points.  This is best taken early.
Your skills have improved to the point where you can pick an additional Tag Skill.  Tag skills increase twice as fast.
The radiation of the wasteland has changed you!  One of your Traits has mutated into something else...
You have inherent protection against physical attacks.
You have extra inherent protection against physical attacks.
You have inherent protection against energy attacks.
You have extra inherent protection against energy attacks.
You have gained +10% resistance to both poison and radiation.
With this Perk, you gain +1 to your Strength when you drop below 1/2 of your max hit points.
You are more alert outdoors and enemies are less likely to sneak up on you.  With this Perk you get a +3 to your perception in random encounters when determining placement.
You pay much closer attention to the smaller details when reading.  You gain 50% more skill points when reading books.
You are an expert when it comes to the fine art of handling explosives. They always go off when they're supposed to, as well as causing extra damage.
You can roll with the best of them.  You gain +20% to your gambling skill.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Strength.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Perception.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Endurance.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Charisma.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Intelligence.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Agility.
With this Perk you gain +1 to your Luck.
Your innocent demeanor makes stealing from people a little easier. You gain 20% to your Steal skill.
With this Perk you immediately gain one experience level.
If both item slots are empty, each unused action point gives you a +2 instead of +1 towards your armor class at the end of your turn, plus 1/12 of your unarmed skill.
When it comes to pleasing sexually, you wrote the book.
Your Karma shines twice as bright. Whether good or bad, your Karma is doubled for any kind of reaction or modifiers.
You are agile, lucky, and always careful. This perk halves your chances of setting off a trap.
You have a better understanding of living creatures and their strengths and weaknesses.  You get a one-time bonus of +10% to Doctor, and you do +5 damage per attack to living creatures.
You get 1 extra slot in your companion limit, but don't forget that more than 5 is always a crowd.
You are a very skilled negotiator.  Not only can you barter with the best of them, but you can talk your way into or out of almost anything.  With this Perk you gain +10% to both Barter and Speech.
You are efficient at arranging your inventory in general.  This makes it much easier to carry that little extra you've always needed.
You do extra damage with fire-based weapons, and enemies always seem to die in the most painful fiery fashion.
You are quick at recovering from being knocked down.
You are an adept salesperson.  With this Perk you gain +20% towards your Barter skill.
You are much less likely to be knocked down in combat.
The blood of a thief runs through your veins. With the Thief Perk, you get a one-time bonus of +10% to your Sneak, Lockpick, Steal, and Traps skills.  A well rounded thief is a live thief.
You can wield weapons much larger than normally allowed. You gain a +3 to your strength for the purposes of Strength checks when trying to wield weaponry.
You have received the Vault City medical training.
Your hit points have been enhanced a little by repeated use of the autodoc.
Your hit points have been enhanced a little more by repeated use of the autodoc.
Your hit points have been lowered slightly by repeated use of the autodoc.
Your hit points have been lowered slightly by repeated use of the autodoc.
You can sling bull with the best of them.
The good thing is that everyone around you has more critical failures in combat. The bad thing is that you do too!
Your metabolic rate is twice normal.  This means that you are much less resistant to radiation and poison, but your body heals faster.
A little slower, but a little bigger.  You may not hit as often, but they will feel it when you do!  Your total action points are lowered, but your Strength is increased.
You are not quite as big as the other villagers, but that never slowed you down.  You can't carry as much, but you are more agile.
One of your hands is very dominant.  You excel with single-handed weapons, but two-handed weapons cause a problem.
Your attacks show a lot of finesse.  You don't do as much damage, but you cause more critical hits.
By not paying attention to any threats, you can act a lot faster in a turn.  This lowers your armor class to just what you are wearing, but you sequence much faster in a combat turn.
You swing harder, not better.  Your attacks are very brutal, but lack finesse.  You rarely cause a good critical, but you always do more melee damage.
You don't have time to aim for a targeted attack, because you attack faster than normal people.  It costs you one less action point for guns and thrown weapons.
By some strange twist of fate, people around you die violently.  You always see the worst way a person can die.
The good thing is that everyone around you has more critical failures in combat, the bad thing is so do you!
You studied less-combative skills as you were growing up.  Your combat skills start at a lower level, but First Aid, Doctor, Speech and Barter are substantially improved.
You are more easily influenced by chems.  Your chance to be reliant by chem use is twice normal, but you recover faster from their ill effects.
Chems only affect you half as long as normal, but your chance to be reliant is also only 50% of normal.
You've got the "right" stuff.  Members of the opposite sex are attracted to you, but those of the same sex tend to become quite jealous.

Since you spent more time improving your skills than a normal person, you gain 5 additional skill points per experience level. The tradeoff is that you do not gain as many extra abilities. You gain a perk every four levels.

You have more innate abilities than most, so you have not spent as much time honing your skills.  Your primary statistics are each +1, but you lose -10% on all skills to start, and receive 5 less skill points per level.

Your basic all leather apparel. Finely crafted from tanned brahmin hide.
Polished metal plates, crudely forming a suit of armor.
A self-contained suit of advanced technology armor. Powered by a micro-fusion reactor, with enough fuel to last a hundred years.
A sharp-bladed cutting and stabbing weapon. Min ST: 2.
A military or police baton. Heavy wood. Min ST: 3.
A large hammer with big handle. Very popular with the muscular crowd. Min ST: 6.
A razor tipped polearm. The shaft is wooden, and the tip is worked steel. Min ST: 4.
A Colt 6520 10mm autoloading pistol. Each pull of the trigger will automatically reload the firearm until the magazine is empty. Single shot only, using the powerful 10mm round. Min ST: 3.
H&K MP9 Submachinegun (10mm variant). A medium-sized SMG, capable of single shot and burst mode. Min ST: 4.
A Colt Rangemaster semi-automatic rifle, in .223 caliber. Single-shot only. Min ST: 5.
A Flambe 450 model flamethrower, varmiter variation. Fires a short spray of extremely hot, flamable liquid. Requires specialized fuel to work properly. Min ST: 6.
A Rockwell CZ53 Personal Minigun. A multi-barrelled chaingun firing 5mm ammunition at over 60,000 RPM. Min ST: 7.
A Rockwell BigBazooka rocket launcher. With the deluxe 3 lb. trigger. Fires AP or Explosive Rockets. Min ST: 6.
A rocket with a large explosive warhead.
A Winchester Model P94 Plasma Rifle. An industrial-grade energy weapon, firing superheated bolts of plasma down a superconducting barrel. Powered by Micro Fusion Cells. Min ST: 6.
A Wattz 1000 Laser Pistol. Civilian model, so the wattage is lower than military or police versions. Uses small energy cells. Min ST: 3.
High tech armor, made out of advanced defensive polymers.
An ancient Desert Eagle pistol, in .44 magnum. Interest in late 20th century films made this one of the most popular handguns of all times. Min ST: 4.
It's a rock. The Granite-Inc. model is an upgraded version. Min ST: 1.
A very solid and heavy piece of metal, specially designed to exert leverage. Or pound heads. Min ST: 5.
Hardened knuckle grip that is actually made out of steel. They protect your hand, and do more damage, in unarmed combat. Min ST: 1.
A Sig-Sauer 14mm Auto Pistol. Large, single shot handgun. Excellent craftmanship. Min ST: 4.
An AK-112 5mm Assault Rifle. An old military model, out of use around the time of the war. Can fire single-shot or burst, using the high velocity 5mm rounds. Min ST: 5.
Glock 86 Plasma Pistol. Designed by the Gaston Glock AI. Shoots a small bolt of superheated plasma. Powered by a small energy cell. Min ST: 4.
A generic fragmentation grenade. Contains a small amount of high explosives, the container itself forming most of the damaging fragments. Explodes on contact. Min ST: 3.
A magnetically sealed plasma delivery unit, with detonating explosives. Creates a blast of superheated plasma on contact. Min ST: 4.
An electromagnetic pulse grenade, generating an intense magnetic field on detonation. Doesn't affect biological creatures. Contact fuze. Min ST: 4.

An H&K L30 Gatling Laser. Designed specifically for military use, these were in the prototype stage at the beginning of the War. Multiple barrels allow longer firing before overheating. Powered by Micro Fusion Cells. Min ST: 6.
A brick of ammunition, .44 magnum caliber, hollow-points.
A cylinder containing an extremely flammable liquid fuel for flamethrowers.
A case of ammunition, .223 caliber, Full Metal Jacket.
A brick of small, lightweight ammunition. Caliber: 5mm, jacketed hollow-point.
A brick of small caliber ammunition. 5mm armor piercing.
A rocket shell, with a smaller explosive, but designed to pierce armor plating.
A small, self-contained energy storage unit.
A medium sized energy production unit. Self-contained fusion plant.
A healing chem. When injected, the chem provides immediate healing of minor wounds.
Legal tender for the world of the wastes.
On old-style ice chest. The hinges are in good working condition.
On old-style ice chest. The hinges are in good working condition.
A knife, balanced specifically for throwing. Made of titanium, and laser sharpened. Min ST: 3.
An average sized bag. Made from weaved brahmin hairs.
A small kit containing basic medical equipment. Bandages, wraps, antiseptic spray, and more.
A chemical solution that bonds with radiation particles and passes them through your system. Takes time to work.
A bottle containing a home-brewed antidote for poison. A milky liquid with floating pieces of radscorpion flesh.
This is a reserved item. DO NOT USE.
A high explosive, consisting of nitroglycerin mixed with the absorbent substance kiselguhr. Includes a timer.
A Wattz Electronics C-Radz model Geiger Counter. Detects the presence and strength of radiation fields.
A pillbox of mind-altering chems. Increases memory related functions, and speeds other mental processes. Highly habit-forming.
A RobCo Stealth Boy 3001 personal stealth device. Generates a modulating field that transmits the reflected light from one side of an object to the other.
This is a Vault-Tec water chip. They are typically packaged in groups of five to a box.
A set of military dog tags. The name Darkwater is readable, but not much else is.
A miniature microphone and transmitting device.
A Wattz Electronics Holodisc tape. This particular tape looks to be into very poor condition.

A Wattz Electronics C-U model motion sensor. Detects the movement of biological material over a distance of meters using a tuned radar device. Having one in your inventory will also help you avoid outdoor encounters (+20% Outdoorsman skill).
A strange piece of fruit. No preservatives and no additional food coloring added.
A set of books, containing information about different scientific fields.
A tool set, containing various useful tools, including pliers.
A study book on the field of electronics. A note on the cover says that it is for the "budding young electrician in everyone!"
A Wattz Electronics Micromanipulator FingerStuff electronic lockpick. For defeating electronic locks and security devices.
An image of a singer. Obviously, very old. The image has a felt coating that is still in good condition.
A flare. Creates light for a short period of time. The paper is a little worn, but otherwise it is in good condition. Twist the top to activate it.
A study book on the concepts and practical use of first aid skills.
A cooked iguana, roasted in it's own skin.
A key. A key will open a particular lock.
A set of locksmith tools. Includes all the necessary picks and tension wrenches to open conventional pin and tumbler locks.
A chunk of Cordex, a military brand of plastic explosives. Highly stable, very destructive. Includes a timer.
A book on the methods and ideals of Scouting. Very practical information regarding outdoor life.
Highly advanced steroids. While in effect, they increase strength and reflexes. Very habit-forming.
An expensive watch. Not really working, but it still looks nice.
A basic backpack, with optional carrying straps.
This brown bag contains instruments and chems used by doctors in the application of their trade.
The severed tail of a radscorpion.
An average sized bag. Made from weaved Brahmin hairs.
A Winchester Widowmaker double-barreled 12-gauge shotgun. Short barrel, with mahogany grip. Min ST: 4.
Shotgun ammunition. This particular ammo is marked: "12-gauge shells, not for use by children under the age of 3."
A electronic security key, color coded red.
A electronic security key, color coded blue.
A pile of junk parts. A little bit of everything.
A model 2043B Radio Communicator, from the fine people at Wattz Electronics. Dependable, rugged, and camouflaged. With the optional RS-121 interface.
A silver butane lighter, in good condition.
A gun rag. A magazine devoted to the practical use of firearms, and the occasional biased review.
Some charred meat and vegetables on a cooking stick.
A Wattz Electronics Play-It-For-Me tape recorder. Plays and records the standard 30 minute high density Record-It-Once tapes.
A special key of some sort.
A bottle of Nuka-Cola, the flavored softdrink of the post-nuclear world. Warm and flat.
Anti-radiation chems to be taken before exposure. No known side effects.
An unique delivery system filled with strange and unknown chemicals of probably military origin. It is supposed to increase the combat potential of a soldier.
A brick of ammunition, .44 magnum caliber, full metal jacket.
A beautiful golden urn, with the name "Harriet" inscribed on the front and ashes inside.
Robes from the Children of the Cathedral.
A cybernetic manipulator, in the shape and form of a hand. Damaged due to the sloppy nature of the removal process.
A Super Sledgehammer, manufactured by the Brotherhood of Steel, using the finest weapons technology available. Includes a kinetic energy storage device, to increase knockback. Min ST: 5.
A Ripper(tm) vibroblade. Powered by a small energy cell, the chainblade rips and tears into it's target. Min ST: 4.
A Wattz 2000 Laser Rifle. Uses micro fusion cells for more powerful lasers, and an extended barrel for additional range. Min ST: 6.
An expensive looking necklace, made from silver, gold and pressed diamonds.
A strange gun of obviously alien origin. Looks like it can support small energy cells, however. Min ST: 2.
A collection of ancient 9x19mm rounds. Heavy grease to preserve them from the environment. Standard bullets.
A Mauser M/96, in 9x19mm Parabellum. In excellent condition. Extremely accurate. Min ST: 3.
A strange device, constructed from an odd technology.
Some type of home brewed beer.
An ancient liquor, from the pre-War era.
A container for the holding and preservation of water or other liquids.
A strong, thick line. About 45 feet in length.

The YK32 is an electrical pulse weapon that was developed by the Yuma Flats Energy Consortium. Though powerful, the YK32 was never considered a practical weapon due to its inefficient energy usage and bulky design. Min ST: 3.

A .44 Magnum Revolver with a speed loader. Min ST: 5.
A Farmer's Best Friend model cattle prod from Wattz Electronics. This model has been upgraded to increase the electrical discharge. Min ST: 4.
